reference_sql:
SELECT brand, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sku <> UPPER(TRIM(sku))) / COUNT(*) AS bad_share
FROM products
GROUP BY brand
alternatives: SELECT brand, AVG(CASE WHEN sku <> UPPER(TRIM(sku)) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS bad_share FROM products GROUP BY brand
SELECT brand, SUM(CASE WHEN sku <> UPPER(TRIM(sku)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS bad_share FROM products GROUP BY brand

other_way.sql: SELECT brand, AVG(CASE WHEN sku <> UPPER(TRIM(sku)) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS bad_share FROM products GROUP BY brand
other_way.tradeoff: The average of a 0 or 1 flag is the share in one step, but a count over a count shows both numbers plainly.
